cases.title: Add valid task to todo list
cases.description: Verify that typing a task into the todo-input field and submitting the todo-form adds the task to the todo-list, clears the input field, and trims any surrounding spaces.

cases.title: Prevent empty or whitespace-only tasks
cases.description: Verify that submitting the todo-form with an empty input or an input containing only spaces does not add any item to the todo-list.

cases.title: Toggle todo item completed status
cases.description: Verify that clicking a todo item in the list toggles its 'completed' class visually and saves the updated state to localStorage.

cases.title: Remove todo item via right-click
cases.description: Verify that right-clicking a todo item suppresses the default context menu, removes the item from the todo-list, and updates localStorage accordingly.

cases.title: Load todos from localStorage on page initialization
cases.description: Verify that on page load, stored todos are retrieved from localStorage using the 'todos' key, parsed as JSON, rendered inside the todo-list, and correctly reflect their 'completed' status.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all specified requirements comprehensively, and present no blockers or untestable scenarios.
All test cases are well-defined, actionable, and directly map to the provided requirements without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_19-R-1: Testable behaviors include adding tasks via data-testid='todo-input' and data-testid='todo-form', verifying updates to data-testid='todo-list', input clearing, space trimming, special character support, and empty task prevention (abnormal path). Boundaries include whitespace-only inputs and empty strings. Requirement e2edev_bench_19-R-3: Testable behaviors include toggling completed status via click, adding the 'completed' class, initial load from localStorage key 'todos', and persistence across reloads. Normal path: clicking an active todo marks it complete. Abnormal/edge cases: missing localStorage key or invalid JSON. Requirement e2edev_bench_19-R-4: Testable behaviors include removing items via right-click (contextmenu event), suppressing default context menu, updating localStorage 'todos', and handling single-item lists and completed items. Requirement e2edev_bench_19-R-5: Testable behaviors include retrieving and parsing JSON from localStorage key 'todos' on page load, rendering <li> items inside data-testid='todo-list', applying 'completed' class based on stored status, and handling empty localStorage. Ambiguities: exact data structure of items stored in localStorage 'todos' (e.g., array of strings vs. array of objects with text and completed properties).
